mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous t-0w collapse in TRANSIT (-22.9) and WORKPLACES (-13.1) signals a broad activity shutdown that will persist for four weeks, keeping RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean of -5.4.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -20 and WORKPLACES falls below -10 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT < -20 and WORKPLACES < -10 at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: The one-week panic drop in RETAIL_REC (-21.1) and TRANSIT (-22.9) is an overreaction that mean-reverts within two weeks as households resume routine shopping, lifting next-28-day RETAIL_REC above the depressed last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is lower than or equal to its last-28-day mean after a single-week RETAIL_REC drop greater than 15 points and TRANSIT drop greater than 15 points.

mechanism_narrative: A tightening-restrictions regime is signaled by RESIDENTIAL rising to +5.9 while WORKPLACES falls to -13.1 and TRANSIT falls to -22.9; these restrictions suppress nonessential retail for four weeks, lowering RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL > +5 and TRANSIT < -20 and WORKPLACES < -10 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than its last-28-day mean when the restriction-signal combination occurs.

mechanism_narrative: The t-0w drop in RETAIL_REC (-21.1) and PARKS (-1.3) reflects a seasonal holiday/weather dip; post-dip normalization over the next four weeks raises RETAIL_REC above the last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is lower than or equal to its last-28-day mean following a week with RETAIL_REC < -15 and PARKS < 0.

mechanism_narrative: The t-0w shift toward essentials, with GROCERY_PHARM at +8.1 and RETAIL_REC at -21.1, indicates substitution away from discretionary retail; if GROCERY_PHARM stays above +5 for two weeks, RETAIL_REC remains depressed.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM > +5 and RETAIL_REC < -15 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than or equal to its last-28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM > +5 and RETAIL_REC < -15 persist for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The drop in PARKS from +7.1 to -1.3 signals reduced leisure outings; if PARKS remains below zero for one more week, leisure-linked retail spending falls within one week, lowering RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS < 0 for one week after being > +5 in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-7-day mean is greater than or equal to its last-7-day mean when PARKS falls below zero after being above +5.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT rebounds above -10 within two weeks, improved access to retail districts lifts RETAIL_REC above its depressed last-28-day mean; the trigger is TRANSIT crossing from below -20 to above -10.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses above -10 after being below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is lower than or equal to its last-28-day mean when TRANSIT crosses above -10 after being below -20.

mechanism_narrative: The joint t-0w pattern of WORKPLACES falling to -13.1 and RESIDENTIAL rising to +5.9 signals a work-from-home shift that reduces weekday retail footfall; if the pattern holds for four weeks, RETAIL_REC declines further.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES < -10 and RESIDENTIAL > +4 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is higher than or equal to its last-28-day mean when WORKPLACES < -10 and RESIDENTIAL > +4 persist.
